capabilities.name: get_vendor_profile
capabilities.description: Retrieves comprehensive vendor trust profile across schedule, commercial, claim, quality, and financial dimensions. Does not compute trend or drift.

capabilities.name: assess_vendor_reliability
capabilities.description: Evaluates a single reliability dimension for a vendor with historical trend. Does not check all dimensions for drift.

output_schema.description: AgentResult with findings=[{current_score, window_days, event_count, avg_impact_delta, trend}].

capabilities.name: detect_behavioural_drift
capabilities.description: Detects negative behavioral drift in vendor performance over time. Does not update trust scores.

output_schema.description: AgentResult with findings=[{dimension, negative_event_count, window_days, avg_impact_delta, flag}, ...] (empty list if no drift).

capabilities.name: update_trust
capabilities.description: Dynamically updates vendor trust score based on verified findings and optional external context. Does not verify if the event actually happened.

verified_event.description: Verified event details, e.g. {impact_dimension, impact_delta, event_type, vendor_at_fault}.

external_context.description: Optional evidence of an external cause, e.g. {relevance: 0-1, explains_majority: bool, summary}.

output_schema.description: AgentResult with findings=[updated trust_profiles row], claims=[{external_cause, applied_delta, reason}].

capabilities.name: compare_vendor_history
capabilities.description: Compares historical reliability trajectories across multiple vendors for bid evaluation. Does not do single vendor deep dives.

output_schema.description: AgentResult with findings=[profile_1, profile_2, ...] and claims=[{note: str}].
